key_insight: GMMag generates crystal structures with site-resolved magnetic moments and uses Gaussian-mixture sampling to steer outputs toward chemical and magnetic targets without retraining.
engineering_relevance: The workflow supports magnetic-material candidate discovery while estimating how repeated chemical formulas limit distinct-candidate yield under a finite generation budget.
method: Combine a graph neural network encoder and transformer decoder in a conditional variational autoencoder.
Retarget generation through Gaussian-mixture sampling and compare magnetic-moment representations and model designs.
Model accumulation of qualifying candidates with distinct chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset.
evidence_signal: The yield model was tested in two separate ten-million-draw runs, and an application identified Nd-containing candidates with reference-absent formulas, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
watch_item: A higher screening pass rate may not produce more distinct qualifying formulas; reported candidates and estimated magnetization still require further validation.
paper_title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
